# md-business

> Open-source (MIT) tools for writing business documents — invoices, specifications, test sheets, API and database designs, investigation reports — as Markdown files checked against JSON Schema. People read them as PDF or Google Sheets; AI agents read, edit and validate the same file through the MCP server built into the desktop app.

Documents stay on the user's disk, usually in a Git repository. There is no server and no account. The desktop app runs on Windows (x64 and ARM64) and macOS. A Chrome extension and a VS Code extension preview the same files.

## Pages

- [Overview (English)](https://meta-taro.github.io/md-business/): what md-business is, the document types it supports, and what is not done yet
- [概要（日本語）](https://meta-taro.github.io/md-business/ja/): the same overview in Japanese
- [Download](https://meta-taro.github.io/md-business/download/): the latest desktop installer for each OS and CPU
- [Past versions](https://meta-taro.github.io/md-business/download/archive/): every released version of the desktop app
- [User guide](https://meta-taro.github.io/md-business/manual/): how to open, edit, validate and export documents
- [操作マニュアル](https://meta-taro.github.io/md-business/manual/ja/): the user guide in Japanese
- [ロードマップ](https://meta-taro.github.io/md-business/roadmap/): what is done, in progress and next, the conditions for continuing or stopping, and what will not be built (Japanese)
- [事例](https://meta-taro.github.io/md-business/cases/): worked examples with made-up data (Japanese)
- [申込フォームが一部の人だけ送れない](https://meta-taro.github.io/md-business/cases/web-form-failure/): an AI agent reads a HAR file and server logs and writes an investigation report whose findings point at saved evidence (Japanese)
- [仕様は変わったのに、検証シートが古いまま](https://meta-taro.github.io/md-business/cases/spec-sheet-gap/): a version bump missing from the revision history is caught, and rows are added to the TSV test sheet; results are left for a person to fill in (Japanese)
- [Privacy policy](https://meta-taro.github.io/md-business/privacy/)
